meta.source_data_tree_note: git tree id of data/ when generated; equals `git rev-parse <commit>:data` for any commit with the same data
meta.unit: health points per hit (per pellet for shotgun rounds; multiply by `pellets`)
assumptions: hostile alignment; a direct hit at point blank: no distance falloff, no ricochet, no penetration
target is a character outside any vehicle; one hit; no instigator tags (entries needing them are not applied)
ammo type changes the result through the HP/AP rule entries and the ammo scalar against armor (DamagePipeline v2 sections 7.3, 7.9)

armor classes are evaluated for Torso.Upper (torso_armor) and Head (head_armor, helmets); the location columns are for an unarmored target. In the game, vests also cover Torso.Middle and Torso.Lower, SuperHeavy armor also covers Pelvis and Arm.Upper, and Heavy, SuperHeavy and Tank helmets also cover Neck, so those locations take less damage on an armored target than their columns show
damage is rounded to one decimal; damage_raw is unrounded
rpm is RoundsPerMinute from the weapon's stats asset; null where the asset omits it (the class default, 600 per Wardogs_InfantryWeapons_Stats_v1, is not applied)
meta.rules: Armor piercing does not add damage. Against an unarmored target it deals 0.8 times FMJ. Against armor it cuts the armor reduction by an amount that depends on the bullet's arms class (a per-class scalar), so it overtakes FMJ from Medium armor for rifle calibers and the Deagle (50AE) and from Heavy armor for 9mm, 45ACP and 45Colt. Where the arms class gives AP a scalar of 1.0 (the 50Cal SR_04) it never beats FMJ. Hollow point doubles unarmored damage, but the HP rule entries (-70, -55, -40 and -40 percent against the armor classes) together with armor scalar 1.5 make it far weaker than FMJ against any armor. Tracer and FMJ are identical. Item tags spelled ArmourPiercing resolve to no modifier and behave as FMJ.
meta.ammo_availability: derived from the ammo items under Content/Items/Resources/Ammo whose Item.Caliber tag is in the weapon's SupportedCaliber
